issues.legal_issue: Acquired land should be valued by reference to feasible plot-wise development and comparable sales of similarly situated plots when the evidence shows ready purchasers for the proposed plots.
material_facts: A workable subdivision plan had been prepared several years before compulsory acquisition and the courts found that purchasers could be found for all the plots shown in it.
Evidence showed willing purchasers for the plots and sales of similarly situated building plots in a comparable development.
The acquired estate had conditions resembling those of the comparable development.

The High Court reduced the District Judge’s plot-wise valuation partly by relying on a stray statement that larger areas might sell for less, although the evidence supported the proposed plot-wise sale.
issues.conclusion: The land should be valued on a plot-wise basis at the District Judge’s rate of Rs. 1-2-0 per square foot; the High Court’s reduction was unjustified and the District Judge’s award was restored to that extent.
issues.legal_principle: In determining market value under Section 23(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, the court may use plot-wise valuation where a feasible subdivision exists and buyers are available, and may assess value by comparing sales of smaller plots similarly situated and having comparable advantages and drawbacks. The block-sale discount is not appropriate merely because the acquired land is extensive when the evidence supports sale of the proposed plots. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_appeal and preexisting_feasible_plot_layout and ready_plot_buyers and comparable_plot_sales

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning compensation for compulsorily acquired land.
predicates.preexisting_feasible_plot_layout: A workable plan for subdividing the land into plots existed before compulsory acquisition was decided upon.
predicates.ready_plot_buyers: The evidence showed that purchasers were willing or available for the plots in the plan.
predicates.comparable_plot_sales: Sales evidence concerned smaller plots with similar location-related advantages and drawbacks.

issues.definition: When a compensation appeal concerns land with a feasible pre-existing plot layout, ready purchasers, and comparable plot sales, the land is valued on a plot-wise basis.

issues.legal_issue: A claimant is entitled to statutory interest for the period during which additional compensation is withheld and unavailable to the claimant pending the acquiring authority’s appeal.
material_facts: Additional compensation awarded by the District Judge was deposited and could have been withdrawn by the claimant.
The Land Acquisition Officer asked that the additional compensation not be paid while an appeal was being considered.

During the appeal, the acquiring authority sought a stay that temporarily prevented payment, and the claimant remained deprived of the additional compensation until the stay application was dismissed.
issues.conclusion: The claimant was entitled to interest at 6 per cent per annum on the additional compensation from 8 July 1948 until 12 May 1949.
issues.legal_principle: The Land Acquisition Act provides for interest on compensation, and the claimant is entitled to that interest for the period in which additional compensation is withheld and the claimant is deprived of its use. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_appeal and enhanced_compensation_deposited and payment_withheld_pending_appeal and claimant_deprived_of_use

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning compensation for compulsorily acquired land.
predicates.enhanced_compensation_deposited: Additional compensation awarded on reference was deposited and available for payment to the claimant.
predicates.payment_withheld_pending_appeal: The acquiring authority caused payment of the additional compensation to be withheld while pursuing or considering an appeal.
predicates.claimant_deprived_of_use: The claimant could not obtain or use the additional compensation during the relevant period.

issues.definition: When additional compensation is deposited but withheld pending an appeal and the claimant is deprived of its use, the claimant is entitled to interest for that period.
